title: Italian Drumsticks
description: Crispy and flavorful Italian-style chicken drumsticks. Perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Dredge the chicken drumsticks in the flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured drumsticks in the beaten eggs, making sure they are fully coated.
Roll the egg-coated drumsticks in the italian seasonings, pressing the coating onto the meat.
Place the coated drumsticks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.
Bake the drumsticks for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Sprinkle with additional parmesan cheese and serve hot.
